customerReply.subject: About your refund request
customerReply.body:
Hello Clara,

Thank you for contacting us about your trail running shoes. We are unable to issue a refund at this time because the request was received after the refund period for this purchase ended. If you believe this is a mistake, reply to this email and a member of our team will take another look.

Kind regards,
Customer Care Team
